title: Morrowindows
statementMd:
Vasya plays The Elder Trolls III: Morrowindows. He has a huge list of items in the inventory, however, there is no limits on the size of things. Vasya does not know the total amount of items but he is sure that are not more than $*x*$ and not less than $2$ items in his inventory. A new patch for the game appeared to view inventory in $*n*$ different modes. Displaying in mode $*i*$ is a partition of all inventory items on pages, each of which (except for maybe the last one) shows exactly $*a*_{*i*}$ items. In addition, each mode shows how many pages $*b*_{*i*}$ is in a complete list. Great! Perhaps this information will be enough for Vasya to find the required number. Moreover, it is very interesting, what is the fewest number of modes in which Vasya can see inventory to determine the number of items in it?

**Vasya cannot use the information that was received while looking on inventory in some mode for selection of next actions. I. e. Vasya chooses some set of modes first, and then sees all the results and determines the size.**

Knowing the number of $*a*_{*i*}$, $*x*$ and assuming that Vasya is very smart, check whether he can uniquely determine the number of items in his inventory, and how many modes he will need to do that if he knows numbers $*a*_{*i*}$, $*x*$ and he is able to know number $*b*_{*i*}$ after viewing items in mode $*i*$.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*x*$ ($0 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}, 2 ≤ *x* ≤ 10^{9}$). The second line contains integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$). Some numbers among all $*a*_{*i*}$ may be equal.

## Output

Output the fewest amount of modes required to uniquely determine amount of items in the inventory. If there is no solution output $- 1$.

## Note

In the second example Vasya is not able to determine items count uniquely because 3 items, as well as 4 items, can be displayed on two pages.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 正在玩《上古卷轴 III：晨风之窗》。他的物品栏中有一大堆物品，不过物品的大小没有任何限制。Vasya 不知道物品的总数，但他确定物品栏中至少有 $2$ 件、至多有 $*x*$ 件物品。游戏出现了一个新补丁，可以用 $*n*$ 种不同的模式查看物品栏。在模式 $*i*$ 下，所有物品会被分页显示，每页（最后一页除外）恰好显示 $*a*_{*i*}$ 件物品。此外，每种模式还会显示完整列表共有 $*b*_{*i*}$ 页！太好了！或许这些信息足以让 Vasya 找出物品的数量。更有趣的是，Vasya 至少需要使用多少种模式查看物品栏，才能确定其中的物品数量？

**Vasya 不能利用在某种模式下查看物品栏时获得的信息来选择下一步操作。也就是说，Vasya 首先选择一个模式集合，然后查看所有结果并确定物品数量。**

已知 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*x*$，并假设 Vasya 非常聪明，请判断当他知道 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*x*$，且能够在以模式 $*i*$ 查看物品后得知 $*b*_{*i*}$ 时，是否可以唯一确定物品栏中的物品数量；如果可以，还要求出他需要使用的模式数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*x*$（$0 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}, 2 ≤ *x* ≤ 10^{9}$）。第二行包含整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）。所有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 中可能有一些相等。

## 输出格式

输出能够唯一确定物品栏中物品数量所需的最少模式数。如果不存在满足条件的方案，输出 $- 1$。

## 说明

在第二个样例中，Vasya 无法唯一确定物品数量，因为 $3$ 件物品和 $4$ 件物品都可能显示为两页。
